description: Ministry of Sports - Amendment for the National Associations of Sports Regulations
reasoning: This gazette content consists entirely of regulatory amendments to the Sports Act, specifically the National Associations of Sports Regulations. It involves the modification of legal/regulatory frameworks (betting/gaming restrictions for sports officials) under the authority of existing legislation (Sport Law 25 of 1973). While a minister's name appears in the signature block, this is standard for regulatory instruments and the core content is purely regulatory in nature, not about government personnel changes or portfolio assignments.
